name: Petitioner's Chamber
summary: Petitioners wait for the crown in a chamber just inside Stormwind Keep. Nobles, church dignitaries, and visiting subjects mingle, drink, or await an audience.

sections.title: A Room of Waiting and Influence
sections.body: Just inside Stormwind Keep, the Petitioner's Chamber lies to your right. Count Remington Ridgewell and Bishop DeLavey wait there for audiences with boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Between formal visits, nobles and clergy mingle, trade gossip, and quietly press their concerns. Who speaks with whom can show where influence lies in the realm.

faq.q: Where is the Petitioner's Chamber located?
faq.answer: The Petitioner's Chamber is inside Stormwind Keep, immediately to your right as you ascend the main entrance ramp.
Petitioners, court attendees, and nobles gather there, including Count Remington Ridgewell, Caledra Dawnbreeze, and Bishop DeLavey of the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why is it also called the Hall of Petitioners?
faq.answer: The chamber is a waiting room for subjects who have petitioned the crown. They wait until Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, the royal council, or the regent grants them entry to the throne room.

faq.q: What happens here during city quests?
faq.answer: Visitors come to the chamber to deliver goods or speak with nobles and clergy in the keep. Some bring refined drinks such as port to aristocrats waiting on court business.

angles.text: For the Alliance, domestic appeals, church affairs, and noble requests await the royal council's attention in this chamber.
As a priest, you may find Bishop DeLavey in this antechamber, where the Holy Light's hierarchy meets the royal court.
